==About==

A {{i|Small Sugar}} is the product of a first growth stage, second tier {{i|Pumpkin}} Harvest. Additionally a Small Sugar can be grown by Planting another Small Sugar in a {{i|Gardening Pot}}. Planting in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. Right-clicking a Small Sugar and selecting "Slice" will give you 2x {{i|Pumpkin Flesh}} and 6x {{i|Seeds of Pumpkin}}. A Small Sugar can be stored in a {{i|Stockbin}}.
